title: add-benchmark-lab-multi-variant-profiling-reporting-pipeline
author: Priya Rao
release_notes: Adds multi-variant profiling runners and a reporting pipeline to aggregate profiling baselines across model variants and quantization profiles. Improves benchmark coverage for perf/cost tradeoffs.
body:
Summary and motivation:
This PR adds a multi-variant profiling runner and a reporting pipeline to the benchmark-lab stack. The goal is to standardize profiling baselines across model variants (fp16/int8/llm-int8), sequence lengths, and representative workload runners so that we can compare latency/throughput/cost tradeoffs consistently and feed results into the benchmark dashboards. This is part of ENG-10234 and ties into the workload reporting pipeline work (ENG-11258).

What this change includes:
- A new multi_variant_runner that orchestrates runs across model variants, quantization profiles, and sequence length buckets. It reuses existing workload runners but centralizes scheduling and metadata tagging.
- A reporting pipeline (Airflow DAG) that ingests profiler outputs, normalizes metrics (p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, memory, energy_est), and writes aggregated baselines to the benchmark datastore.
- Exporters and small schema additions to support variant metadata (model_variant, quantization, seq_bucket).
- CI additions: unit tests for scheduler logic, integration test that runs a trimmed sample run in CI (mocked), and flake suppression for a previously flaky perf test.
- Docs: README for profiling baselines and instructions for adding new variants.

Commits (high level):
- 8e1f3a2 add multivariant runner and orchestration primitives
- 4b2d9f1 add airflow DAG and reporting transforms
- 9c7b4e5 add exporters + schema updates for variant metadata
- a1d2c3b add tests for scheduler and reporting transforms
- b5f6e7d update docs and changelog

Files changed (high level):
- benchmark-lab/runners/multi_variant_runner.py (new)
- benchmark-lab/pipelines/reporting/dag_multi_variant.yaml (new)
- benchmark-lab/profiling/baselines/variants_schema.sql (new)
- benchmark-lab/exporters/variant_exporter.py (new)
- benchmark-lab/tests/test_multi_variant_runner.py (new)
- benchmark-lab/tests/integration/test_reporting_integration.py (modified to add variant fixture)
- benchmark-lab/profiling/baselines/README.md (modified)
- ci/flake_suppression.yaml (modified)
- docs/benchmark-lab/profiling.md (new)

Review conversation (high level):
- Jordan Lee (reviewer): "LGTM overall, please add more logging around the per-variant aggregation and ensure the exporter is idempotent. Also add a small unit test for the seq_bucket edge-case."
- Priya Rao (author): "Addressed: added debug logs to aggregation step, implemented idempotent upsert in exporter, added seq_bucket edge-case test. PTAL."
- Samir Patel (reviewer): "CI integration test failed once due to timeouts; recommend shortening the mocked run and making retries explicit."
- Priya Rao: "Adjusted integration test to use a smaller synthetic workload and added explicit retry/backoff in the test harness. Rerunning CI."
- Diego Alvarez: "Verified schema and exporter writes, approving once CI is green."
- Jordan Lee: "Approved"

CI summary:
- unit-tests: pass
- integration-tests: pass (after fix)
- lint: pass
- type-check: pass
- perf-check (smoke): pass
- codecov: 92%

Notes on reliability and flakiness:
- The previous perf integration test in benchmark-lab was flaky under low-resource CI runners; this PR replaces the long-running end-to-end sample with a deterministic mocked workload for CI while keeping the full runs in nightly clusters. This reduces CI flakiness while preserving coverage.

Migration and operational notes:
- The new schema adds a variants table; the migrations are additive and safe for existing dashboards. The exporter uses upserts keyed by (model_name, model_variant, quantization, seq_bucket, commit_sha).
- Nightly job: the new Airflow DAG is scheduled as a nightly job; ops should watch the first few runs and verify expected row counts in the benchmark datastore.

Testing performed:
- Local end-to-end runs on a small GPU instance across three model variants and two sequence buckets.
- Integration test run in CI with mocked workload confirmed transformation correctness.
- Manual verification of dashboard ingestion and row counts.

Merge details:
- Merge method: squash and merge
- Merged by: Jordan Lee
- Merge commit message: "Add multi-variant profiling runner and reporting pipeline (ENG-10234)"

Follow-ups and TODOs:
- Add per-variant gating in the dashboard UI to filter baselines by quantization and seq_bucket (PM/Frontend ticket ENG-11790).
- Add energy_est measurements in exporter when host telemetry is available.
- Expand nightly coverage to include larger-scale representative workloads.

If there are any questions about runner configuration or how to add new model variants, see the new docs at docs/benchmark-lab/profiling.md or ping me on Slack.
